title: Fourier regularity and junta expectations
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$ and let $\rho$ be a probability density on $\bbr_2^n$. Every nonempty coordinate set of size at most $k$ has Fourier coefficient zero for the function obtained by expressing $\rho$ on the sign cube if and only if, for every sign-valued function $h$ on the sign cube that depends on at most $k$ coordinates, the expectation of $h$ under $\rho$ (transported from the sign cube to the binary cube by the coordinatewise binary-to-sign bijection) equals the uniform mean of $h$ on the sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: Fourier regularity is required for each nonempty coordinate set of size at most $k$
the expectation identity is required for every sign-valued function depending on at most $k$ coordinates
